summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.95/gal
summary.blurb: As of June 4, 2026, regular unleaded in Wisconsin averages $3.95 per gallon — down 25¢ from a week ago, down 33¢ from a month ago. Among metro areas, Fond du Lac is cheapest ($3.75) and Rhinelander priciest ($4.21).
